purpose: Baseline reconstruction of the gold grid described in the user's TikTok; not an exact replication or deployable strategy.
known_rules: Also test the creator's fixed-size alternative
execution: Enter immediately at the first active minute's ask plus slippage. Fixed starting size, no compounding.
Add when ask falls $10 from the last grid fill; gaps fill at the available quote. Refuse additions that fail available-margin checks.
Close when bid covers weighted entry cost, commissions, financing, exit slippage, plus $1 per total ounce.
Start the next basket at the next active minute after a close, not repeatedly within the same minute.
Liquidate the entire basket when account equity reaches 50% of used margin, then cease trading permanently for that run. No deposits or restarts.
Track open positions at bid less estimated exit costs. Include unresolved final baskets in equity and final return.
Apply continuous financing on prior notional over elapsed calendar time, including weekends. This is an assumption, not historical broker swaps.

Reconstruct both open-low-high-close and open-high-low-close minute paths with linear transitions. Bid/ask extrema are paired assumptions, not synchronized tick data; these are sensitivity scenarios, not rigorous bounds.

predeclared_experiments.main: Doubling and fixed-size, full available 2019 onward and a fresh 2022 onward account, both minute-path orders.

benchmarks: Unleveraged spot gold from the same feed; existing Alpaca split/dividend-adjusted SPY daily data at the same date range. Different trading clocks; not execution-equivalent instruments.
selection_policy: Report the complete parameter grid, do not choose the strongest historical setting. All periods are exploratory baseline evaluation; no untouched test set is claimed.
out_of_scope: Broker-specific swaps, partial liquidation and historical margin changes
